newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Leader in Indian cable deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Leader in Indian cable deal.

text.p: Malaysian cable maker Leader Universal Holdings Bhd announced that it has concluded negotiations to acquire an Indian wire and cable maker, the national Bernama news agency said on Friday.
Leader said it had acquired Incab Industries Ltd for an undisclosed sum, but said the stake amounted to around nine percent of Incab's share capital.
Incab is a leading maker of cables for the Indian power industry, Bernama said.
It said the acquisition would be made through Leader's 55 percent owned subsidiary Leader Universal (Mauritius) Co Ltd, which is a joint venture company with Indian industrialist P.K. Saraf.
Leader officials could not be immediately contacted by Reuters.
Leader and Saraf will subsequently acquire a total of 51 percent of Incab through various means, including a rights issue, said Bernama.
Incab's acquisition will serve as a base for the company to penetrate the Indian cable market, the Malaysian news agency said.

"The country's (India's) cable market is expected to grow in line with the increase of its existing electrical power generating capacity of 75,000 megawatts to 100,000 megawatts by the year 2000," the statement said, Bernama reported.
Leader shares were down 15 cents to 5.20 ringgit at the close of trading on Friday.
